# pyad1 test image

`text-and-pictures.ad1` … `.ad4`: an AD1 v4 image in four 2 MiB segments, made with FTK Imager 3.4.3.3 from a folder of text and pictures. Copied unchanged from [pcbje/pyad1](https://github.com/pcbje/pyad1/tree/74b21889410fb40b96e3f1f1f6ab369019d6984d/test_data), Apache License 2.0 (`LICENSE`). The image also serves as a test for [dissect.evidence](https://github.com/fox-it/dissect.evidence).
